units.source_text: 岛村觉得很面熟，原来就是在滑雪场的宣传照片上看到过的那个艺妓，她身穿赴宴服，下套雪裤，同驹子并肩坐在滑雪板上。

en.t: Shimamura felt she looked very familiar; she was the geisha he had seen in the ski resort publicity photograph, wearing banquet clothes with snow trousers underneath, sitting beside Komako on skis.

units.source_text: 她是个丰满而落落大方的中年女人。

en.t: She was a plump, self-possessed middle-aged woman.
